D: A Queensland mining engineer leads Australian tunnellers digging under enemy lines on the Western Front.
P: Serve the main when the tunnellers come up for air.
S: Chewy oat and coconut biscuits with chopped macadamias

Golden oat, coconut and golden syrup biscuits with chopped Queensland macadamias, crisp at the edges and chewy in the middle. Mix 100g rolled oats, 150g plain flour, 60g desiccated coconut, 60g chopped macadamias and 120g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then stir in 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water so it foams. Stir into the dry mix. Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly on lined trays and bake at 170C for 12 to 14 minutes until golden. Cool on the trays to crisp.
Corned beef, cheddar, lettuce and mustard pickle in soft rolls

Soft rolls stacked with thick-sliced corned beef, sweet mustard pickle, sharp cheddar and crisp lettuce, a proper Queensland lunch. Split and butter 4 soft white rolls. Spread each base generously with 1 tbsp sweet mustard pickle. Layer with 300g thickly sliced corned beef, a slice of vintage cheddar from 100g and a few leaves of iceberg lettuce. Add thinly sliced tomato and a crack of pepper, close and cut in half.
M: Crusty potato and corned beef hash topped with a fried egg

Crispy pan-fried corned beef and potato hash with onion and Worcestershire, topped with runny fried eggs and a dollop of brown sauce. Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes and drain well. Fry 1 diced onion in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add the potatoes and 400g diced corned beef and press flat. Cook over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning in sections, until crusty. Splash with 1 tbsp Worcestershire and add chopped parsley. Fry 4 eggs and sit one on each serve with brown sauce.
W: Fruit cake from home with brandy butter
Warm fruit cake with brandy butter and sharp cheddar

Thick slices of rich fruit cake, warmed and spread with sweet brandy butter, served with a wedge of sharp cheddar. Beat 100g soft butter with 100g icing sugar until pale, then beat in 2 tbsp brandy a little at a time until fluffy. Chill 20 minutes. Wrap an 800g fruit cake in foil and warm at 160C for 15 minutes. Cut into thick slices and serve with the brandy butter and 150g vintage cheddar cut into wedges.
K: Hot milk cocoa with dark chocolate and condensed milk

Hot cocoa made with dark chocolate and sweetened condensed milk, rich and warming the way the troops brewed it at the front. Heat 900ml full cream milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Whisk in 3 tbsp cocoa, 80g chopped dark chocolate and 120ml condensed milk until smooth and frothy. Add a pinch of salt to bring out the chocolate. Pour into 4 enamel mugs and serve straight away while it is piping hot.
